domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czj9tecb4nj5MfUyYk

18.4.0 release acceptance, round 1, record R-P0 of wave anchor #32908. Three runner subagents (effort high) and one independent verifier (effort xhigh) dispatched by the maintainer's project session, in one cold cloud container, in parallel; text only.

**Result: 24/24 judged · 19 PASS / 4 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** No planned item. No security finding.

- The 1 FAIL is a **product defect and a regression**: a non-admin pending approver cannot open an approval request in the console (approvals.account-app-entry clauses 3 and 4). RUNNER rule 7's independent verify pass **agrees** and traces it to #32428. Reproduction rule below; extracted card at close-out.
- The 4 PARTIALs are coverage gaps (two `blocked(dependency)` clauses the items' knownGaps already name, one undriven door, one fixture half). Parked on #32908.
- Retests: **#32111, #24784, #32141, #31488, #32138, #32156, #32139, #32140 HOLD**.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `main` @ `5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11` (2026-11-12). The Console was built from `ui/` in the same tree; the served entry `index-BlQDOpR0.js` is byte-identical to `packages/console/dist` (sha256 `aa925767…`).
- **Build:** `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 16 s; `pnpm build --concurrency=2` 119/119 tasks, 12m17s; `pnpm console:build` cache hit. The showcase artifact was compiled once; every showcase boot ran `--no-compile --no-watch` with `OS_PORT` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported.
- **Runners** (each its own port range and file DBs under `/tmp`):
  - R1 API half, 14 items, ports 41510–41526 (PostgreSQL fixture on 41525), 22 boots including walled `group` and `isolated` boots started by hand (see accuracy notes).
  - R2 browser half, 6 items plus browser retests, ports 41530–41538, Playwright chromium, sign-in through the form.
  - R6 CLI half, 4 items, ports 41620–41637, 34 boots or attempts: a `create-objectstack@17.7.0` blank scaffold DB, the `cli-18-prerelease-db` restore, production `os serve` legs and MCP stdio legs.
  - V1 verifier (rule 7), ports 41660–41661, its own boot, persona and fixture.
- **Deviations:** a container restart at about 23:25Z killed every process; captured verdicts were kept and unfinished pins, walks and boots re-run from scratch.
- **Hygiene:** every port free at the end; `git status` clean; no `installed-packages` in the tree; the showcase `dist/objectstack.json` hash unchanged.
- **Time:** 23:14Z → 00:12Z, verifier to 00:24Z. Roughly 1 : 2 environment to testing.

## Scope

Selector `priority:P0`, resolved with `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs priority:P0 --json` at `5fb79bc0`: 24 items, none blocked. Revisions are in the verdict list below. The retest legs re-judge the P0 rows that failed in QA runs #32102 and #32135, and the owed rows from `scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs` that sit in this set (the rest are in #32940 and #32949).

## Tier 1 pins (rule 6)

- R1: objectql 251 (engine), plugin-security 29, plugin-auth 57, runtime 79 (dispatcher over a stub engine), rest 22 (route handler), dogfood 47 + 155 + 85 + 19 (in-process HTTP).
- R6: cli 191, runtime 40, mcp 27, plugin-security 3.
- R2: the browser items' pins are listed in its comment; the approvals pin `approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageMemberPermissions-13324.test.tsx` passes because it mounts the schema as present, so it cannot see the FAIL below (a pin scores only the layer it drives).

## Reproduction rule (the FAIL)

**F-1 · approvals.account-app-entry clauses 3 and 4 · product defect.**
1. Stock showcase boot on a fresh DB. As admin, invite a member (`POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member`) and sign it up with the returned `invitationId`; bind positions `showcase_contributor` and `showcase_finance` (`POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position`, 201 each).
2. As the member, create a `showcase_invoice` it owns on a non-churned account, then `PATCH {status:"sent", issued_on}`. This starts a `flow:showcase_invoice_signoff` request with the member in `pending_approvers`.
3. Sign in as the member through the form; Avatar › Profile › Approvals. The inbox lists the request (clauses 1 and 2 pass).
4. Click the request title, or cold-load `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/component/approvals/inbox?request=ID`.

**Expected** the request page with its decision actions (Approve / Reject …). **Actual** `/apps/com.example.showcase/sys_approval_request/record/ID` renders "Object Not Found — Object "sys_approval_request" definition missing" with only "Back to home". Wire, as the member: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_approval_request` → **404** `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` "Metadata item not found or access denied." (also `sys_approval_action`); `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID` and `/actions` → 200. Admin control on the same URLs: meta 200, the page renders Approve / Reject / Reassign / Send back / Request info / Recall.

- **Reproductions:** R2 4 times in 3 fresh browser contexts across 2 boots (en and zh UI); V1 independently on its own boot and persona, twice by row click, twice by cold deep link, and by direct load under three app segments (`com.objectstack.account`, `com.example.showcase`, `setup`) with a 10 s settle each.
- **Traps ruled out:** stale-console-bundle (served chunk hash equals dist, built after HEAD); wrong-persona (in-page get-session names the member; it is in `pending_approvers`); hydration-race (definitive 404 on the meta read, 10 s settle); automation-input (URL and ref-targeted click agree); app-segment dependence (fails under all three).
- **Rule 7:** V1 verdict **AGREE-FAIL** (full record in its comment).
- **When it broke:** last PASS QA run #31486; PARTIAL with the approve and deep link working in #32135 at `ff04ad81`. V1 places the cause at **#32428** (`7d13a333`, merged 2026-11-12T00:30Z), which lies between `ff04ad81` and `5fb79bc0`, with high confidence. Counterfactual without a rebuild: the same tree and console booted with `OS_ALLOW_UNMASKED_OBJECT_METADATA=1` (the switch #32428's changeset names as restoring the earlier object visibility) gives the member meta 200, data still 403, and the request page renders Approve / Reject / Send back from the row click and the cold deep link. The subject commit #32850 (which app the request opens under) is not the cause.
- **Mechanism (read at 5fb79bc0):** `resolveObjectSchemaMaskPosture` (`packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls.ts`) answers `hidden` when the caller fails the object read check, and the meta routes answer absent before any fetch. `member_default` grants nothing on `sys_approval_*` because those rows reach approvers only through `/api/v1/approvals/*`; the console's `ApprovalRecordReads` reroutes the row reads there but still needs the object schema from `/meta`.
- **Wider effect seen by V1:** the approval panel on the invoice's own record page also loses Approve / Reject for the member. The hover Approve / Reject on an inbox list row still works (200, tally 1 of 2), so approvers are not fully blocked, but they decide blind: no request detail, timeline or submitted snapshot, no comment, attach, Send back, Reassign or Request info, and no decision on a request that collects decision outputs.

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

About 13 runner-minutes in all, after the clauses had verdicts, on the same or a fresh boot. Personas: admin, plain members, contributor-bound member, walled operator, anonymous, revoked and unknown MCP keys.
- R1 (~4 min): data by-id with empty and unknown ids; empty createMany / updateMany; action activation and flow toggle doors with unknown names, string booleans, empty bodies and a member; query filter boundaries (`$in [null]`, one-element and reversed `$between`, `$top=-1`, `$skip=abc`, trailing-backslash `$like`); member reads of sys_audit_log, datasources, self-grant. Nothing filed.
- R2 (~3 min): `/api/v1/approvals/requests/:id` and `/actions` with unknown, blank and not-party ids (404 `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`, no enumeration; anonymous 401); bad object and page routes in the showcase app. Nothing filed; three cosmetic observations parked on #32908.
- R6 (~6 min): MCP HTTP door with revoked, unknown and absent keys; filter-oracle on an unreadable field (403 on `aggregate_records` and `query_records`); the ownership ceremony with a mismatched, malformed and empty plan file, and a re-apply. Nothing filed; one observation parked.

## Checklist-accuracy notes and fixture gaps

Parked on #32908 at close-out; the full lists are in the R1, R2 and R6 comments. The ones that change how a runner works:
- `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs walled-boot` spawns `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` without `--no-compile --no-watch` (about line 335), so on a shared checkout it rewrites the showcase artifact and starts a watcher. R1 booted the walls by hand.
- approvals.account-app-entry clauses 3 and 4 say the request opens under "`/apps/‹appId›/…` of this component route"; since #32850 it opens under the record-owning app (`objectHostAppSegment`). The Language picker offers 简体中文 (`zh-Hans`), not zh-CN.
- platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render: Setup now has 48 leaves (the step says 46).
- cli.organization-ownership-ceremony: A-3 of #32102 is still open (a refused boot rotates the restored telemetry shard away before the guard refuses); A-2 still applies (the printed apply command has no `--out`).

The full per-clause tables follow as comments, one per runner, then the verifier's record.
